{{La Bangu/en}}
'''La Bangu''' is a dialect of Lojban that introduces new rules into the language compared to Standard Lojban (which is described in [[CLL|Complete Lojban Grammar]]). 90% of the ideas in La Bangu is just an implementation of [[jbocre: zasni gerna cenba vreji|zasni gerna]] first proposed by [[User:Xorxes|xorxes]].

Other names are "''LST Lojban''", "'''la zasni gerna jbobau'''", "[[La Bangu: ilmentufa|ilmentufa]] lojban". 

===About some new stuff for La Bangu===
[[User:Gleki|la gleki]] started preparing two new resources for it.
# “[[Stub: Lojban for Newbies. version 0.17 alpha|Lojban for newbies]]” (L4N), which teaches La Bangu to beginners.
#:It’s a continuation of la gleki's [https://docs.google.com/document/d/101dgwoA60kGbn7ii9HzXJBfZu-RDUzKGcQ9bMkEkCjc/edit?usp=drive_web crash course] but it also uses appropriate parts of [[L4B]], [[Lojban Wave Lessons|Wave lessons]] and [[CLL]] as well as different insights from [[Lojban IRC|IRC]] residents and textbooks on other languages.
#:It tries not to use lojbanic terminology much. It explains most lojbanic terms in ordinary language (e.g. tanru are “compound verbs” etc.)
#:L4N is to be written in native languages of learners. The first edition is written in English.
#:Examples of it's parts: "Lojban as a simple language for everyday use", "Phrasebook", "Lojban for logicians", "Math in Lojban"
# Another resource is '''lo se tcena ke jbobau gerna''' book (Extended Lojbanic Grammar, [[ELG]]). It’s based on CLL and is intended for those who’ve read L4N and now want more. ELG is to be written in Lojban.

==Differences from Standard Lojban==
Here are the differences of La Bangu dialect of Lojban from the one described in [[CLL]]:
#[[How to use xorlo|xorlo]]<nowiki/>fication except '''le'''
#*Does '''le''' need to be replaced with '''lo'''? It’s not a problem of matching '''le''' with RegExp (/\ble\b/g) in the source code of ELG but what function should '''le''' have in La Bangu? If it’s useless then why not retain it as a synonym of '''lo''' (and in this case it’s a pity xorlo replaced one word with another when it should have just changed the philosophy/definitions behind them).
#*Another option is mapping '''lo'e''' - '''le''' to attributiveness - referentiality from Keith Donellan philosophy thus shutting down '''le'e'''
#[[cmevla]] is a class of [[brivla|verbs]], so you can say '''i la moxamed morsi cu jmive'''
# New connective system.
#*GIhA has two alternatives. Instead of '''gi'a''' you can say '''gi ja''' or '''vau ja'''. Instead of '''gi'e''' you can say '''gi je''' or '''vau je''' and so on. You can still use''' gi'a''', '''gi'e''' etc. if you prefer them. It is not a reform but rather a new preferred style retaining all past usage.
#*GA has an alternative. Instead of '''ga''' you can say '''ja gi'''. Instead of '''ge''' you can say '''jegi'''. Instead of '''gu''' you can say '''jugi '''and so on. You can still use''' ga''', '''ge''', '''gu''' etc. if you prefer them. It is not a reform but rather a new preferred style retaining all past usage.
#*GUhE  has an alternative. Instead of '''gu'a''' you can say '''gu ja'''. Instead of '''gu'e''' you can say '''gu je '''and so on. You can still use''' gu'a''', '''gu'e''' etc. if you prefer them. It is not a reform but rather a new preferred style retaining all past usage. Thus '''gu''' has another meaning. Two meanings of '''gu''' can never be mixed up neither by the computer syntactical parser of Lojban text nor by humans.
#*A is out of favor. It's better to use JA everywhere where you used A.
#* '''zi'e''' is a synonym of '''je'''
#Numbers removed from the grammar but preprocessed 1=>pa, 2=>re and so on granting l33t style official status (within the frame of La Bangu) (see [[Stub: L33t gismu]]).
#[[The Dot Side]] applied.
#'''na''' is to be dealt with.
#Sets theory has to be dealt with.
#Forethought '''be''' is added
# '''vu'o''' closing several clauses added.
#As for terminology a better match between lojbanic and normal linguistic terminology is to be achieved (e.g. “modals” will be called “prepositions” and so on).
#'''soi''' is bridi relative clause. '''sei''' works exactly the same except that '''go’i''' doesn't copy '''sei'''-clause but does copy '''soi'''-clause. This makes '''fi’o''' rather useless.  '''lo ractu cu citka lo cirla soi lo denci cu tutci'''
#BAI and other sumtcita (except tenses, causals, directions) are out of favor and moved out of main parts of ELG.
#Possibly merging selma’o SEI and LE
#FA have the grammar of tags.  '''.i [SE] FA bo''' is possible.
#Probably the main feature of ELG is that new sections related to semantics will be added (subjunctives come to mind first as well as describing semantic regularisation of all gismu chapter by chapter. Probably now there is something like that in CLL for tenses although in cmavo form).

==Differences from zasni gerna proposed by xorxes==
Compared to [[jbocre: zasni gerna cenba vreji|zasni gerna]] first proposed by [[User:Xorxes|xorxes]] La Bangu has the following differences:
* '''sa''' is not removed as it has many uses
* [https://groups.google.com/d/topic/lojban/ExtEumbYoQg/discussion Connective unification] is not a reform anymore but rather a new preferred style retaining all past usage. '''vauje''' is the same as '''gi'e''' and '''gi je'''. '''gu''' is retained in the old meaning while '''JAgu''' is also used as a synonym of '''gu'e''' (two meanings of '''gu''' can never be mixed up neither by the parser nor by humans). Standard Lojban has too many uses in the corpus. Unlike xorxe’s mad proposals no cmavo is removed from the language. GIhA is just a synonym of giJA, A = JA, GA = JAgi, GUhA = JAgu. It will eliminate breaking past usage for connective system (A, GA, GIhA and GUhA are not removed from the language, they are just out of favor in La Bangu).
* numbers removed from the grammar but preprocessed 1=>pa, 2=>re and so on granting l33t style official status (within the frame of La Bangu) (see [[Stub: L33t gismu]]).

==Creation==
As noted in the recently uploaded video on Lojban++ Lojban is the best way in machine translation as all other attempts mostly fail. So it’s not any schism or anything like that. ELG is a must, it’s our duty in the face of humanity.

== Philosophical aspects ==
Lojban had multiple word to denote the same operator: "logical AND". Indeed, there were '''je''', '''.e''', '''gi'e''', '''gu'e''', '''zi'e'''. Almost the same for other logical operators (for joining relative clauses there was only '''zi'e''', though).

Now we have one word for that: '''je''' (retaining other words for backward compatibility). Which is great.

Read also a short paper on [[La Bangu: Is Lojban an auxlang?|Lojban and auxlangs]].[[Category:La Bangu]][[Category:La Bangu]]
